zh: 模型选择器的每一行标出该模型此刻的倍率：峰价、谷价与限时活动三种状态各有自己的图标，颜色区分贵与便宜，倍数后面跟着距离切换还有多久，鼠标停在徽章上读到「此刻的判定 · 多久后转为哪个状态」的完整一句。判定按各家供应商自己发布的作息表与自己的时区做（工作日窗口之外、周末与法定节假日整日算谷价，跨零点的窗口归它开始的那一天，夏令时切换按真实时刻计算）；没有作息表的模型不显示徽章。作息表来自公开目录 offpeakclock.com 的一份快照：宿主半边取一次、在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-claude-style/peakrate.json` 留一份缓存、每 24 小时刷新一次，经 `/dsh-claude-style/peakrate` 下发（`POST` 强制重拉），连不上时按插件包里带的那份判定；浏览器半边只在功能装上时读一次，第三方地址不经过页面。设置页「输入区」页新增「峰谷电表」子项，关闭后各行的徽章消失，模型选择器关闭时该项目变灰不可操作。
en: Every row of the model picker now carries the rate in force for that model: peak, off-peak and a dated promotion each get their own mark, the colour separates expensive from cheap, the multiplier is followed by how long it lasts, and hovering the badge reads one line — the judgement now, and what it becomes and when. The judgement is made from each provider's own published schedule in that provider's own time zone (outside the weekday windows, and on weekends and public holidays in full, the rate is off-peak; a window crossing midnight belongs to the day it starts; a daylight-saving change is resolved against real instants), and a model with no schedule published carries no badge. The schedules come from one snapshot in the public offpeakclock.com catalog: the host half fetches it, keeps a copy in `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-claude-style/peakrate.json`, refreshes every 24 hours and serves it over `/dsh-claude-style/peakrate` (`POST` fetches again first), and falls back to the copy shipped in the package when it cannot be reached; the browser half reads it once when the feature installs, and the third-party address never goes through the page. The Composer settings tab gains a Peak rate meter sub-row under the model picker: off removes the badges, and turning the picker off greys the row out.
